description: Read or update the order for the final quote. Pass explicitly available renewal, referral or channel codes in coupon_codes before payment starts. Tell the person which codes were added and their valid/invalid status. Give confirmation_url to the person to review codes and pay themselves. Never submit payment for them. Save order_id and order_capability before passing confirmation_url to the person. After payment, use get_order even if the original session is lost.
name: create_order
title: Prepare order
